# jwt-handler
> Minimal JWT generation and validation using HMAC-SHA256 (HS256), built on Node's crypto module with zero dependencies.

Signs and verifies JSON Web Tokens with the HS256 algorithm only. Handles expiration claims, base64url encoding, and signature verification. Does not implement RS256 or refresh tokens; use a full JWT library if you need asymmetric signing.

## API
- `JWTHandler` - class with `sign(payload, expiresIn)` and `verify(token)` methods

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
